This template is to be used to cite videos from the official [[The LEGO Group|LEGO]] YouTube channel.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{LEGOYouTube|video=|text=|date=|quote=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the Youtube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a channel's playlist, use <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{LEGOYouTube|video=aQzaHi0CwRQ|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga - Official Reveal Trailer|archivedate=20201124223443}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{LEGOYouTube|video=aQzaHi0CwRQ|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga - Official Reveal Trailer|archivedate=20201124223443}}

<hr />
If a backup link is unavailable:<br />
<code><nowiki>{{LEGOYouTube|video=2yTr5oS99_c|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – Gameplay Reveal|nobackup=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{LEGOYouTube|video=2yTr5oS99_c|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – Gameplay Reveal|nobackup=1}}
